title: Primetime
description: A television set for the work: 28 project channels, a real remote, and a programme guide.
signature: A short tuning scan resolves into the selected project's public screen.
holdback: The cabinet and remote are recognizable and consistently drawn, and channel selection reveals actual work. But the numbered remote duplicates previous/next browsing and a searchable guide rather than establishing a necessary navigation system. On mobile the remote is mostly below the viewport while the same browsing remains available through television arrows. No timing, sound, or physical-weight credit can be established from the captures.
slopCauses: The retro television and remote act as a browsing costume.
The Archivo display face is shared with most reviewed directions.
